config-manager-sync.autosync.description: When enabled, DSH keeps config in sync in the background: uploads locally-changed config automatically, pulls and merges only when it detects a new remote snapshot; the timer is just a fallback poll and no-ops when nothing changed. Local writes happen only when there are no conflicts or manual-decision items.
config-manager-sync.autosync.intervalHint: On interval / DSH startup, checks for a new remote snapshot and pulls+merges only if one exists (no upload); local config changes trigger an upload.
config-manager-sync.autosync.skipReasonConflictCount: {reason} ({n} more section(s) on the remote need confirmation — handle them on the sync page)
config-manager-sync.autosync.title: Auto Sync
config-manager-sync.channel.clearConfirmMessage: This removes the local configuration of "{channel}", its saved credentials and its auto-sync switch. Remote snapshots and local backups are untouched; you can configure it again later.
config-manager-sync.channel.clearGitSignOut: The git channel access token is deleted too: your GitHub sign-in becomes invalid and must be redone (it does not come back automatically).
config-manager-sync.channel.openHint: Remote sync runs through a sync channel: a private Git repository or a WebDAV server. Click the button to configure or change it in the dialog.
config-manager-sync.channel.perChannelHint: Auto sync, sync mode, encryption and remote snapshots are configured independently for each channel (Git / WebDAV / object storage / Gist).
config-manager-sync.channel.title: Sync Channel
config-manager-sync.cloud.accessKeyIdHint: An identifier, not a secret (it is written into the config file); put the secret in the field below.
config-manager-sync.cloud.apiBaseUrlHint: Blank = https://api.github.com; change it for GitHub Enterprise.
config-manager-sync.cloud.apiBaseUrlInvalid: API base URL must be http(s) and contain no username/password
config-manager-sync.cloud.bucketHint: 3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots or hyphens; must start and end with a letter or digit.
config-manager-sync.cloud.bucketInvalid: Invalid bucket name: 3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, and no ".."
config-manager-sync.cloud.credentialsWriteFailed: Writing the secret into DSH credentials failed (config was not saved)
config-manager-sync.cloud.endpointHint: Without bucket name or credentials, e.g. https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com.
config-manager-sync.cloud.endpointInvalid: Endpoint must be http(s) without whitespace, query string or fragment
config-manager-sync.cloud.endpointUserinfo: Endpoint must not contain a username or password
config-manager-sync.cloud.filePrefixHint: File name prefix inside the gist; blank = dsh-sync.
config-manager-sync.cloud.gistIdHint: The hex id at the end of the gist URL (e.g. https://gist.github.com/<user>/<id>).
config-manager-sync.cloud.gistIdInvalid: Gist ID must be a 5-64 character hex string
config-manager-sync.cloud.gistLargeSectionHint: The gist channel does no content offloading: a single request returns all file content, any oversized single file is truncated, and the number of files is capped — large sections such as conversations are a poor fit. Use a Git / WebDAV / object-storage channel instead.
config-manager-sync.cloud.invalidTitle: Some required fields are missing or malformed:
config-manager-sync.cloud.pathStyleHint: Usually required by self-hosted services such as MinIO; leave unchecked to follow the vendor default.
config-manager-sync.cloud.prefixHint: Blank = root prefix; leading/trailing slashes are ignored.
config-manager-sync.cloud.prefixInvalid: Object key prefix must not contain a backslash, "//" or ".."
config-manager-sync.cloud.providerHint: All five vendors share one SigV4 implementation; endpoint and addressing style follow the vendor defaults.
config-manager-sync.cloud.providerUnknown: Vendor is not in the supported list
config-manager-sync.cloud.regionHint: V4 signing scope, e.g. us-east-1 / cn-hangzhou.
config-manager-sync.cloud.secretHint: The value is written only into the DSH credential slot ({ref}): never into the config file, logs, or responses; leave blank to reuse the saved secret.
config-manager-sync.cloud.secretWriterRequired: The host exposes no credential writer, so the secret cannot be saved
config-manager-sync.cloud.tokenHint: The value is written only into the DSH credential slot ({ref}): never into the config file, logs, or responses; leave blank to reuse the saved token.
config-manager-sync.config.repoUrlHint: Private Git repository URL (https / ssh / local path). Use the credential field below for the auth token; never embed it in the URL.
config-manager-sync.config.saveHint: Form changes are saved automatically (password/token written securely into DSH credentials, never into sync files or logs); you can also save explicitly with the button.
config-manager-sync.config.title: Repository
config-manager-sync.config.tokenHint: Securely written into DSH credentials (ref {ref}); never written into sync files or logs. Leave blank to reuse the saved credential.
config-manager-sync.config.tokenMissing: No token: public repos can be pulled, but pushing will fail
config-manager-sync.github.clientIdHint: Requires the githubClientId plugin config (the client_id of your GitHub OAuth App).
config-manager-sync.github.description: Authorize via the GitHub OAuth device flow: no manual token entry — after you approve in the browser, the token is written into DSH credentials automatically.
config-manager-sync.github.title: GitHub Sign-in
config-manager-sync.github.tokenInvalid: GitHub sign-in is no longer valid — please sign in again.
config-manager-sync.history.autosyncReasonEncrypted: The remote snapshot is encrypted, so auto sync skipped it (sync manually)
config-manager-sync.history.autosyncReasonMutationLocked: The environment lock is held (another task is running, or a stale lock needs reclaiming)
config-manager-sync.history.autosyncReasonUnchanged: No new remote snapshot to merge
config-manager-sync.history.emptyHint: Records appear here after your first push / one-click sync / auto sync.
config-manager-sync.history.remoteMovedHint: Remote snapshots moved to the artifact library
config-manager-sync.history.title: Sync History
config-manager-sync.mode.atLeastOne: Select at least one section to sync
config-manager-sync.mode.decryptPassword: Decryption password (for encrypted snapshot pull/sync, optional)
config-manager-sync.mode.decryptPasswordHint: Once entered it is saved in the local credential store and reused automatically; it is only ever used when the pulled snapshot is actually encrypted — plaintext backups never use the password. Use "Delete saved password" to remove it.
config-manager-sync.mode.encryptAutosyncNotice: Encrypted snapshots are only produced/consumed by manual push/pull; auto sync has no password, so it skips encrypted snapshots and reports them in history.
config-manager-sync.mode.encryptHint: Encrypt the sync snapshot with a password (AES-256-GCM). The password is kept in the local DSH credential store (~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml) for reuse: it is never written to sync files, logs or backups (unless "Export secrets" is checked together with encryption). Auto sync cannot decrypt encrypted snapshots, so it skips them and reports it in sync history.
config-manager-sync.mode.gistSessionsWarn: The current channel is GitHub Gist and "Conversations" is selected: a gist returns all file content in one request, truncates any oversized single file, and caps the number of files, so syncing a large section may fail or be truncated. Use a Git / WebDAV / object-storage channel for conversations, or clear that section.
config-manager-sync.mode.hint: Click the button to tick the sections to sync: the ticked set is the sync scope (recommended sections are ticked by default and can be changed any time).
config-manager-sync.mode.includeSecretsHint: Write real credential values (~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml) into the encrypted snapshot so another machine can restore them with the sync; checking this auto-selects encryption, and secrets never enter a plaintext snapshot.
config-manager-sync.mode.mcpHint: MCP servers are written back as patch lines (restored to their original layer on import). Stdio servers installed from a package (npx / uvx / pipx) are portable by themselves; if command / args / cwd contain absolute paths, or the target machine lacks the runtime, the import analysis will say so — the config is still written, but the server may fail to start there.
config-manager-sync.mode.passwordClearNotice: Unchecking "Encrypt backup" deletes the saved password.
config-manager-sync.mode.passwordSavedHint: A password is already saved locally: leave the fields empty to reuse it, or type a new one to replace it.
config-manager-sync.mode.persistHint: The section selection is saved locally: both auto sync and manual push use this configuration (persists across restarts).
config-manager-sync.mode.pickerHint: Changes apply and are saved immediately (closing the dialog finishes the task).
config-manager-sync.mode.sectionsHint: Portable sections sync by default; device-specific sections (plugin files, credentials status, sessions) only participate when you explicitly tick them here.
config-manager-sync.mode.sessionsLimit: How many recent sessions to sync
config-manager-sync.mode.sessionsLimitHint: Session content is sensitive, so only the latest 5 are included by default (0 = select the section but carry no sessions); the unit is a session directory, so all logs of one session travel together.
config-manager-sync.mode.sessionsPickHint: Only the picked conversations are synced (this wins over the count above). Picking none returns to the "latest N" mode.
config-manager-sync.mode.sessionsWorkspaceWarn: Conversations are selected but the "Workspaces" section is not: on the target machine they may not be attributed to any workspace and stay invisible. Selecting "Workspaces" too is recommended.
config-manager-sync.mode.title: Sync Sections
config-manager-sync.privateRepoHint: Security requirement: the sync repository MUST be private (a public repo would expose your configuration). The auth token is only used for repository access and is never written into sync files, commit content, or logs.
config-manager-sync.pull.needsReview: Contains items that need human decisions (conflicts / secrets / dependencies / installs)
config-manager-sync.pull.previewHint: Read-only diff preview above; nothing is imported. One-click import is not supported in this version; use the Import wizard to apply a downloaded backup if needed.
config-manager-sync.pull.title: Pull Diff Preview
config-manager-sync.push.title: Push Result
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.created: Created private repository {name}; the address has been filled in.
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. "My config repository (published by dsh-config-manager)"
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.empty: No private repository available — use "Create a new private repository".
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.hint: Lists the **existing private repositories** in your GitHub account (most recently updated first); picking one fills the repository URL below. You can still type an address by hand (ssh / local path / repositories not in the list). The list requires GitHub sign-in. Newly created repositories are always private — a public repository would expose your config contents.
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.label: Pick one of my repositories
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.loadFailed: Could not load the repository list — retry, or type the address below.
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.name: Repository name
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.nameInvalid: A repository name may contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens (max 100 characters, cannot start with a dot).
config-manager-sync.repoPicker.privateOnly: Newly created repositories are always private: a public repository would expose your config contents.
config-manager-sync.section.description: Sync portable configuration across devices via a private Git repository (secrets do not sync by default; checking "Export secrets" with encryption lets them travel inside the encrypted snapshot)
config-manager-sync.section.label: Remote Sync
config-manager-sync.sections.title: Synced Sections
config-manager-sync.snapshots.unreadableHint: {n} remote snapshot(s) cannot be parsed and are missing from this list: {files}
config-manager-sync.status.title: Sync Status
config-manager-sync.syncflow.bulkHint: Bulk decisions apply to every pending item listed above (conflicts included); error items must be handled individually.
config-manager-sync.syncflow.compat.good: Compatibility: good (backup from an older DSH)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.compat.partial: Compatibility: partial (cross-platform / missing sections / newer version — review)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.compat.unsupported: Compatibility: unsupported (format version out of range)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.conflictUnresolved: Conflict item {itemId} has no resolution yet (keep current / use backup)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.importPartial: Partly successful: {n} item(s) did not take effect (the rest were written; nothing rolled back)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.importPartialToast: Partly successful: {n} item(s) did not take effect — check the result details
config-manager-sync.syncflow.importRollbackIncomplete: Import failed and the overall rollback did not complete: some changes could not be restored (see the warnings below)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.ineffectiveItems: Items that did not take effect
config-manager-sync.syncflow.listScope: {review} item(s) are listed below for your decision; the other {auto} are adopted by default and need no per-item handling.
config-manager-sync.syncflow.needsRestart: Some changes require a DSH restart to take effect
config-manager-sync.syncflow.pushFirstBaseline: No remote snapshots yet: this push creates the first sync baseline
config-manager-sync.syncflow.rollbackFailedItems: Items not rolled back (need manual handling)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.rollbackIncomplete: Rollback incomplete: {n} item(s) could not be restored automatically (the configuration may be left partially changed)
config-manager-sync.syncflow.rollbackPartialToast: Rollback incomplete: {n} item(s) could not be restored
config-manager-sync.syncflow.title: One-Click Sync
config-manager-sync.toast.channelClearFailed: Failed to disconnect the sync channel
config-manager-sync.toast.configNothingToSave: Enter a channel URL before saving
config-manager-sync.toast.githubCodeCopyFailed: Auto-copy failed — copy the one-time code above manually
config-manager-sync.toast.snapshotsUnreadable: {n} remote snapshot(s) could not be read (list is incomplete) — see the note below
config-manager-sync.toast.workdirRelinked: Working copy now points at the configured repository address
config-manager-sync.warnings.title: Section Warnings
config-manager-sync.webdav.passwordHint: Securely written into DSH credentials (ref {ref}); never written into sync files or logs. Leave blank to reuse the saved credential.
config-manager-sync.webdav.presetHint: Pick a common WebDAV server to prefill the URL; templates containing <placeholders> need to be replaced with your real server/username.
config-manager-sync.webdav.title: WebDAV Configuration
config-manager-sync.webdav.urlHint: WebDAV server root URL (https://…). Sync snapshots and the index are stored under a dsh-config-manager/ subdirectory of that URL. Do not include a username/password in the URL.
config-manager-sync.webdav.usernameHint: HTTP Basic auth username (not sensitive, may be shown).
config-manager-sync.workdir.hint: The Git working copy used for sync. Every sync makes its origin follow the configured repository address; if it still fails after an address change, re-point or clone it again here.
config-manager-sync.workdir.mismatch: Still pointing at the old address
config-manager-sync.workdir.missing: Not created yet (cloned on first sync)
config-manager-sync.workdir.recloneConfirmMessage: The local working-copy directory will be deleted and cloned again from the remote. Your local config and the remote snapshots are unaffected, but local commits that were never pushed will be lost — push once from the sync page first if you need them.
config-manager-sync.workdir.title: Working copy
